column1: # duty-cycle-registry.tsv — the OPT-IN list of roles the freeze-watchdog watches (Exec's design, 2026-06-16).
# A row = "watch this role." No row = not watched (not opted in / not migrated). To watch a new role, add a
# row; that's the whole registration step (no per-fire skill mutation).
# "Actively cycling right now" is DERIVED from the session-log lifecycle the agent already maintains — NOT a
# field here (m-36: reuse an existing mechanism instead of a parallel one the agent must remember to update):
#   • no session log for the role today (on origin/main)  → hasn't STARTed → not checked (no morning false-+)
#   • session log carries  <!-- DAY-CLOSED -->            → cleanly STOPped → not checked (no overnight false-+)
#   • else → checked: heartbeat age (newest "(role)"-tagged commit on origin/main) vs threshold_h.
# A live cycle commits every fire (push-to-main-routinely), so age > threshold_h = genuinely frozen.
# threshold_h = a bit more than the role's LARGEST in-window inter-fire gap (so a healthy role never trips).
# wake_start/wake_end = waking/alerting window (local hour, [start,end)); outside it we don't alert PM even if
#   a role died without STOPping (overnight-courtesy gate — secondary to the DAY-CLOSED gate above).
# active_since = when the role joined the watch list (bookkeeping only).
